items.title: Local cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex is the injective hull in degree zero
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the zeroth local cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex, with support in the closed point of a Noetherian local ring, with an injective hull of the residue field, and shows the complex has no other cohomology (author lemma at source lines 3641-3648, label lemma-local-cohomology-of-dualizing). The proof (source lines 3650-3670) rewrites the local cohomology as a homotopy colimit of internal homs out of the finite length quotients, replaces each term by the corresponding truncation of an injective hull compatibly with the transition maps, and identifies the resulting colimit with the hull through the description of the hull as the union of its truncations (proof lines 3658-3668). The comparison of the homotopy colimit with the hull is the substance. H3.
